existingReason: server: ensures the SDK runtime is loaded and memoises the Sections JSON per list Not a generator gap: the component loads the SDK runtime before it renders and memoises the Sections JSON per list, which are server concerns (PkRuntime), so it stays hand-written unless the element takes the sections as data it can read itself.

params.note: Sent as JSON text ([{ tag, title, open, lines, columns, rows, code }]); the gallery frame draws it in the Details drawer as text. PkGallerySection.ForBlazor() is the Blazor section, computed from the package's mappings.
